name: accounting
description: Invoices, expenses and a VAT and income summary for any period: JSON routes the agent and the page call, and the books as a widget on the first screen. Data in accounting.json in the app's home.
mount: a row `- id: accounting` / `name: accounting` before the server row in blend.yaml

config.store: an AccountingStore for tests (default: accounting.json in the app's home)
config.today: what day it is, for tests (default: the system clock, UTC)
